target.title: fix: clean up queued chat turns on abort
target.body:
Closes #102914

AI-assisted: yes

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where queued chat followup turns could remain in Gateway memory when the owning abort signal fired before queue completion. This affected the queued chat/followup lifecycle and could leave stale run identities in `chatQueuedTurns` until the turn was otherwise processed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Gateway now attaches a once-only abort listener when a queued chat turn is registered. The listener removes only the exact current queued entry that still owns cancellation, so stale listeners cannot remove a reused run id and retired collect-mode entries remain as idempotency guards until aggregate completion.

## User Impact

Gateway queued chat turns clean up promptly after owner aborts without allowing duplicate dispatches for retired collect entries. This reduces stale in-memory queue state while preserving existing idempotency behavior.

## Evidence

Real Gateway queue behavior proof from the production queue module, run against PR head `3aecbe6bf2e443db0cff0ab4df473293dbb3fe80`:

```text
REAL_GATEWAY_QUEUE_PROOF commit=3aecbe6bf2e443db0cff0ab4df473293dbb3fe80 surface=src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.ts
PASS queued_turn_registered {"runId":"proof-owner-abort","mapSize":1,"signalAborted":false}
PASS owner_abort_fired_and_entry_removed {"runId":"proof-owner-abort","mapSize":0,"signalAborted":true}
PASS stale_abort_did_not_remove_reused_run_id {"runId":"proof-reused","mapSize":1,"currentSessionId":"new-session"}
PASS current_reused_owner_abort_removed_entry {"runId":"proof-reused","mapSize":0}
PASS retired_collect_identity_survived_abort {"runId":"proof-retired","mapSize":1,"abortable":false}
PASS retired_collect_identity_removed_on_completion {"runId":"proof-retired","mapSize":0}
REAL_GATEWAY_QUEUE_PROOF result=pass
```

The proof script imported `registerQueuedChatTurn`, `retireQueuedChatTurnCancellation`, `completeQueuedChatTurn`, and `getQueuedChatTurn` from `src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.ts`, then exercised the runtime queue map directly. It shows the queued turn is registered, the owner abort signal fires, the entry is removed, stale aborts do not remove reused run ids, and retired collect identities survive abort until completion.

Additional validation:

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/chat-queued-turns.test.ts src/gateway/server.chat.gateway-server-chat-b.test.ts` passed after final rebase: 6 files, 148 tests.
- One local `autoreview` pass found a collect-retirement blocker; this PR includes the fix and a regression test for retired collect identities surviving abort until completion.
